CAT.TITLE: Certified Accounting Technician (CAT)
CAT.SUBTITLE: A vocational qualification designed to give you the skills you need to support financial managers.
CAT.DESC: The Certified Accounting Technician (CAT) qualification is a globally recognized credential that provides a strong foundation in all areas of accounting. It is designed to equip you with the necessary skills to support financial managers in any industry. By completing this program, you will master financial recording, cost accounting, and payroll management, positioning yourself for a successful career in finance.
CAT.AUDIENCE: This course is ideal for students, entry-level finance professionals, and anyone looking to start a career in accounting without prior experience. It is also suitable for those working in support roles who wish to formalize their skills.
CAT.REQ: There are no formal academic qualifications required to start the CAT qualification. It is open to anyone with a passion for numbers and a desire to build a career in finance.

CERT_IA.TITLE: Certificate in International Auditing (Cert IA)
CERT_IA.SUBTITLE: Gain a comprehensive understanding of International Standards on Auditing (ISAs).
CERT_IA.DESC: The Certificate in International Auditing (Cert IA) offers a deep dive into the International Standards on Auditing (ISAs). This qualification helps you understand how ISAs are applied in practice, ensuring you can conduct audits that meet global standards. It is an essential credential for auditors operating in an international environment.
CERT_IA.AUDIENCE: Designed for qualified accountants, auditors, and finance professionals who need to update their knowledge of ISAs or who are moving into an auditing role where ISAs are used.
CERT_IA.REQ: A background in auditing or accounting is highly recommended to get the most out of this course. It is suitable for ACCA members and non-members alike.

CERT_IFR.TITLE: Certificate in International Financial Reporting (Cert IFR)
CERT_IFR.SUBTITLE: Master the basics of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
CERT_IFR.DESC: The Certificate in International Financial Reporting (Cert IFR) provides a broad introduction to the field of International Financial Reporting and IFRS Standards. It traces the history of the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) and its roots to the present day. This course is designed to help you understand how IFRS Standards are used around the world.
CERT_IFR.AUDIENCE: Professional accountants, auditors, and finance degree holders who want to understand IFRS Standards. It is also suitable for those working in multinational companies.
CERT_IFR.REQ: An educational background in accounting or familiarity with financial reporting concepts is recommended.
TOPICS: The Nature and Operations of the IASB
The Status and Use of IFRS Standards
Presentation of Financial Statements and Profit

CFA.TITLE: Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
CFA.SUBTITLE: The gold standard in the investment industry.
CFA.DESC: The Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation is the most respected and recognized investment credential in the world. It demonstrates a mastery of the skills needed for investment analysis and decision-making in today’s fast-evolving global financial industry. Earning the CFA charter places you among the elite in the finance profession.
CFA.AUDIENCE: Investment professionals, portfolio managers, research analysts, wealth managers, and finance students who aspire to reach the top of the investment profession.
CFA.REQ: To enroll, you must have a bachelor's degree (or be in your final year) or have a combination of professional work experience and education totaling four years.

CIA.TITLE: Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
CIA.SUBTITLE: The only globally recognized internal audit certification.
CIA.DESC: The Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) designation is the only globally accepted certification for internal auditors and remains the standard by which individuals demonstrate their competency and professionalism in the internal audit field. It signifies that you possess the knowledge, skills, and competencies to effectively carry out professional responsibilities for any internal audit anywhere in the world.
CIA.AUDIENCE: Internal auditors, risk management professionals, compliance officers, and anyone seeking to lead in the internal audit profession.
CIA.REQ: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent). Alternatively, certain levels of internal audit experience can substitute for education.

CMA.TITLE: What is CMA?
CMA.SUBTITLE: Certified Management Accountant
CMA.DESC: The Certified Management Accountant (CMA) credential is the advanced professional certification specifically designed to measure the accounting and financial management skills that drive business performance. Achieving the CMA demonstrates your mastery of financial planning, analysis, control, decision support, and professional ethics.
CMA.AUDIENCE: Management accountants, financial analysts, finance managers, controllers, and CFOs who want to prove their strategic value.
CMA.REQ: A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university and two continuous years of professional experience in management accounting or financial management.

CME.TITLE: What is CME?
CME.SUBTITLE: Capital Market Examination
CME.DESC: The CME examinations are a set of regulatory exams mandated by the Capital Market Authority (CMA) of Saudi Arabia. They ensure that professionals working in the Saudi capital market possess the necessary technical knowledge, understanding of regulations, and ethical standards to perform their roles effectively.
CME.AUDIENCE: Professionals working or intending to work in the Saudi Stock Exchange (Tadawul), brokerage firms, asset management companies, and compliance roles.
CME.REQ: Requirements vary depending on the specific CME exam (CME-1, CME-2, CME-3, etc.). Generally, a background in finance or law is beneficial.

CPA.TITLE: What is CPA?
CPA.SUBTITLE: Certified Public Accountant
CPA.DESC: The Certified Public Accountant (CPA) is the statutory title of qualified accountants in the United States and is recognized globally as the gold standard in accounting. It signifies the highest level of competence, integrity, and dedication to the public interest in the accounting profession.
CPA.AUDIENCE: Public accountants, auditors, tax consultants, financial advisors, and professionals aiming for leadership roles in accounting firms or corporate finance.
CPA.REQ: Typically 150 semester hours of education (Master's level), passing the four parts of the Uniform CPA Exam, and fulfilling work experience requirements (varies by state).

DIPIFRS.TITLE: What is DipIFR?
DIPIFRS.SUBTITLE: Diploma in International Financial Reporting
DIPIFRS.DESC: The Diploma in International Financial Reporting (DipIFR) is an advanced international qualification developed by the ACCA. It is designed for finance professionals who need to acquire a detailed and practical knowledge of IFRS Standards. It goes beyond the basics to cover complex reporting issues.
DIPIFRS.AUDIENCE: Professional accountants, auditors, and finance managers who are already qualified in national standards and need to transition to or master IFRS.
DIPIFRS.REQ: A professional accounting qualification (e.g., CPA, CA) OR three years of relevant accounting experience.
TOPICS: Presentation of Financial Statements and Additional Disclosures
Preparation of External Financial Reports for Combined Entities and Associates

SOCPA.AUDIENCE: Accountants and auditors who wish to practice publicly or hold senior accounting positions within Saudi Arabia.
SOCPA.REQ: A Bachelor's degree in Accounting (or a related field with specific accounting credit hours) is required to sit for the exams.
